about: Shared-GLB asset manifest (docs/design/ASSET_PIPELINE.md). One entry per asset: the master GLB (PNG, what Godot imports) and the web variant (meshopt + WebP, what Three.js loads). files, tris, bounds_m, colliders and tools.gltf-transform/meshoptimizer/sharp are written by tools/assets/make-web-variant.mjs from the files on disk; the rest is written by hand from command output.

assets.name: Kit_Lot_Container20_01
assets.description: The Lot's 20 ft site-office container: open ends, a side door on +x 7 m toward +z (c_west; c_east is the same piece turned 180 degrees), windows, corner castings, hazard eaves band. Weathered corrugated steel, rust, grime, plywood floor.
assets.scale_note: World metres at the game's pet scale (x4): the body is CONTAINER in src/shared/world/lot/layout.ts, 9.6 x 10.4 x 24 m (a real 20 ft box, 2.44 x 2.59 x 6.06 m, x4); size_m adds the proud door leaf, rails and castings.
assets.axes: +Y up, front +Z (open end), pivot at the base centre on the ground

provenance.source: tools/assets/build-container.py (bpy): geometry, LODs, COL_ boxes, UV atlas, painted textures, Cycles AO bake, glTF export. No .blend is kept; the script is the source.
provenance.web_variant: tools/assets/make-web-variant.mjs (glTF-Transform dedup, prune, textureCompress WebP q84 / normal q92, meshopt medium)
provenance.deterministic: two builds give byte-identical GLB and PNGs (sha256 in files)
provenance.generator_inputs: none: no image-to-3D model, no reference images, no paid API (Scenario / Grok blocked by the network policy)

assets.licence: Original work of the Corgis vs Cats project, generated by its own scripts; no third-party content.
assets.collision: COL_ boxes = the sim's container colliders (props.ts container()); tests/unit/glb-container-colliders.test.ts checks them within 1 cm against createWorldData('the_lot')

godot.master: PASS: editor import (--import) and runtime GLTFDocument both load it; tree root/LOD0-2/13 COL_, LOD0 AABB size (10.26, 10.46, 24.2) m on y = 0, StandardMaterial3D with albedo 1024x1024, normal, roughness, metallic and ao textures
godot.web: REJECTED: 'required extension EXT_meshopt_compression is not supported' and 'required extension KHR_mesh_quantization is not supported' (import and runtime). A WebP-only copy (no meshopt / quantization) imports and validates PASS, so EXT_texture_webp is fine; the meshopt geometry is the web-only part
godot.consequence: Godot imports the master (PNG) GLB; the web variant is Three.js-only, as ASSET_PIPELINE.md plans
